10-Layer Architecture

The complete MCP development platform

From discovery to deployment — every tool you need to build, test, verify, and ship MCP servers.

Layer 1

Discovery & Catalog

Public MCP server directory with ratings, search by capability, community reviews.

Layer 2

Testing & Validation

Visual tool discovery, live tool call testing, raw JSON-RPC console.

Layer 3

Verification & Trust

Verification badges with startup logs, benchmark speed, memory profiles.

Layer 4

Performance Metrics

Execution latency, memory footprint, connection stability, error tracking.

Layer 5

Security Scanning

Static analysis, permission audit, network monitoring, sandbox execution.

Layer 6

Version History

Git-like versioning, changelog generation, breaking change detection.

Layer 7

AI Documentation

Auto-generated tool descriptions, usage examples, best practices suggestions.

Layer 8

Multi-Agent Orchestration
